mentions.name: Single-player Thronebreaker-inspired card game
mentions.description: A single-player card game in development, inspired by The Witcher's Thronebreaker. The creator draws on 15 years of playing card games like Magic and passively absorbing game design, and is learning game development from scratch to build it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my own card game. Been playing games like Magic for 15 years now and thought I'd soaked up enough game design passively to make something of my own. Want to make a single-player game similar to the Witcher's Thronebreaker.
